turns.text: IAM PARIS (https://iamparis.eu) is an open platform that documents integrated assessment and energy-system models and publishes their results. It offers a model catalogue, study results with interactive data explorers and policy questions, data stories and an application library. Its studies come from EU research projects such as PARIS REINFORCE, IAM COMPACT, NDC ASPECTS, ENCLUDE and DECIPHER. In this chat you can ask for model descriptions, study results (for example `CO2 emissions for World in 2050`) and links to IAM PARIS pages.
turns.title: IAM PARIS
